description: FlexColor 4.8.13 Mac, X1 warm: one preview, then one scan at 3200 ppi of a small frame (~0.91 x 0.97 cm), 6x7 holder 50200403, 2026-11-17. Captured with tools/capture/cap3.py. Serial number anonymised; no image data.
notes: response = complete response (up to 64 bytes); response_head = first 64 bytes only
direction: in = scanner to host, out = host to scanner
async = issued asynchronously by FlexColor (image reads); status not captured for these
completed_from: response longer than 64 bytes completed from that fixture (identical first 64 bytes; complete responses read with tools/x1probe)
